sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Mathgen was an Irish god. He was a minor member of the Tuatha Danann, the magical tribes of the goddess Danu. Koch reports that Mathgen, also written Matgen, appears as a druid of the Tuatha in the text the Second Battle of Mag Tuired. The Old Irish name Mathgen comes from the Old Celtic Matugenos, which means auspiciously born. Mathgen may connect to the Welsh Math, the magician-king of the Mabinogion.
objective: Document Mathgen, the Irish god and druid of the Tuatha Danann.
